Unable to access at such a low level as an addon.

Edit: Enhanced the Logic, as all that matters is if something is drawn in the Split range or not for the Split to be updated, and Occlusion Culling isn't the only thing that can result in some Splits being wasted, albeit it is the most likely to do so. Likewise I've Improved the Logic to allow for discarding splits in the middle (for example split 2 when 1,3,4 are being rendered, something that with previous logic wouldn't be done, as it'd always discard in this order - 4th,3rd,2nd,1st)
